identity.name: CryptoSergs
identity.notes: The original March 2021 CryptoSergs were OpenSea Storefront ERC-1155 assets. The verified legacy ERC-721 migration contract burns the original Storefront token and calls the successor Sergs ERC-721 contract. The generic OpenSea Storefront contract is intentionally excluded from collection-level API scans because it is shared by unrelated projects.

short_description.value: A limited series of 1,111 algorithmically generated Serg characters that later gained dedicated ERC-721 migration and successor contracts.

evidence.note: Etherscan project overview describes 1,111 unique Sergs launched in March 2021 and identifies the verified CryptoSergs contract.
Verified successor source establishes the CryptoSergs-to-Sergs migration relationship.
